name: COMP_014
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (56%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
Benign (37%) is in the same 90% set; invasive risk is 3% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 56%, Benign 37% | Close second class |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90%) | Cannot separate two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96 / 98th percentile | Not flagged; OOD high |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 InSitu | Mixed; 3 Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score lowers invasive association [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; associated with non-invasive disease [F3] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; small association · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 2) · ↑ invasive · High score, but spot check 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful. Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60).
- **Concepts**: Not shown to reflect the classifier (CI −0.005 to 0.007 includes 0). Necrosis (3/20), mitoses and normal lobules (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Benign and in situ cannot be separated; 3 of 5 similar cases are Normal.
- Reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69); OOD percentile is 98.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2**: confirm atypical cells stay within ducts (in situ versus benign atypia).
2. **Region 3**: highest invasive contribution; look for stromal invasion and lymphocytes.
3. **Regions 0–3**: superior margin called involved [F7]; verify on slide.
